facts.label: Situações improváveis
facts.sub: Use if + passado simples para uma situação improvável ou irreal e would + verbo base para o resultado. Com I, he, she, it, use weren’t ou were.

facts.label: Situação improvável
facts.sub: Use if + passado para algo que não é real agora: If I had more time, I would learn the guitar. Você não tem mais tempo hoje, mas imagina como seria.

facts.label: Negativo
facts.sub: Para negar uma situação, use weren’t ou didn’t: If I weren’t so busy, I would start tomorrow. If I didn’t work late, I would go.

compare.ask: If I had more time, I would learn.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “se eu tivesse mais tempo, eu aprenderia violão”.
compare.tip: Diga: “If I had more time, I would learn.”
compare.us: Em inglês, use if + passado e would + verbo base: If I had more time, I would learn the guitar.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.

items.s: If I had more time shows a situation that is not real now.
We say “If I would have time, I learn.”
items.why: We say: If I had time, I would learn.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: If I had more time shows a situation that is not real now. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If I would have time, I learn.” → Falso (We say: If I had time, I would learn.)
A bike has two wheels. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A walk home · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool evening on a quiet street in Cork. Carla and Bia walk home from work. Both are tired after a long day. The river is calm and dark. A bike passes near them. They begin to talk about free time.

“Bia, if I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.” says Carla. “Really? If I had more time, I would paint the walls of my room.” says Bia. “You have a free weekend. Why don’t you paint then?” says Carla.

paragraphs: “Dreams are cheap! If we want time, we have to plan our week.” says Bia. “True. If I stopped watching TV, I would get two more hours a day.” says Carla.
